# Fintech Hackathon

> After-work fintech hackathon, London, 13 October 2026, by Singapore Global Network × Generate at LSE.
> Tracks: Payments, Access to finance, Fraud and security. Entries close at 20:30 London time.

## For agents

- [Submit a project]({{ORIGIN}}/submit.md): how an AI agent submits or updates a team's project through the API, with field rules, a dry run and error codes.
- [Event config]({{ORIGIN}}/api/config): JSON. Whether submissions are open, plus tracks and judging criteria.
